class.name: TerrainHeightmap
class.brief_description: Stores an editable height field and four terrain paint layers, and generates a mesh.
class.description: [TerrainHeightmap] provides a serializable foundation for terrain creation. Heights are stored in row-major order (X first, then Z); each grid cell has four normalized paint weights in its RGBA channels. Use [method build_mesh] to construct an [ArrayMesh] with vertex colors containing the paint weights. The consuming material must interpret vertex colors as blend weights. Brush coordinates and radii are in grid-cell units. The emitted [signal Resource.changed] signal indicates that the resource changed; an existing mesh must be regenerated explicitly. This class does not implement terrain chunk streaming, a viewport brush editor, vegetation, physics collision, or GPU virtual texturing.

method.name: build_mesh
method.description: Builds an indexed triangle mesh using the height field, central-difference normals, normalized UVs, and vertex colors containing the terrain paint weights. Grid cells have a spacing of [param cell_size] world units. Returns [code]null[/code] if [param cell_size] is not positive and finite.

method.name: erode_talus
method.description: Performs deterministic, conservative thermal erosion over a four-neighbor grid. Each iteration moves a fraction of the height difference exceeding [param talus] toward the steepest lower neighbor. [param rate] must be between 0 and 1, and [param iterations] must be between 0 and 1000. This is not hydraulic erosion.

method.name: get_height_at
method.description: Returns the height of the cell at [param x] and [param z].

method.name: get_paint_at
method.description: Returns the normalized RGBA weights for the four paint layers at a cell.

method.name: paint_layer
method.description: Paints layer 0 through 3 with linear radial falloff, moving the existing weights toward the selected layer. [param strength] is in the range 0 to 1. Layer weights continue to sum to one.

method.name: sample_height
method.description: Bilinearly samples the height field, clamping coordinates outside the grid.

method.name: sculpt
method.description: Raises or lowers the terrain within a positive [param radius] using linear falloff.

method.name: set_height_at
method.description: Changes a single cell height. Non-finite heights and out-of-range indices are rejected.

method.name: smooth
method.description: Smooths terrain by blending original heights toward their 3x3 neighborhood average with radial falloff. [param strength] is in the range 0 to 1. Uses a snapshot so results do not depend on scan order.

members.member: Terrain vertex-grid dimensions. Both dimensions must be at least 2, at most 2048, and their product at most 1,048,576. Resizing preserves the overlapping cells.
Row-major vertex heights. All values must be finite; array length must equal [code]dimensions.x * dimensions.y[/code].
Row-major normalized RGBA layer weights. Each color must have nonnegative components in [code][0, 1][/code] whose sum is approximately 1.
